explication: youtube-dl is a command-line and embeddable downloader that turns supplied URLs or search terms into selected media files. Its principal workflow is: accept options and targets, match a site extractor, resolve media metadata and formats (including playlist/search results), select formats, download media, then optionally postprocess it. The README also documents proxy and geo-bypass controls, flat playlists, subtitles, and extractor listing. The graph reflects these documented capabilities; sampled excerpts are partial, so some internal dispatch details are represented only at the documented subsystem level.
